d: US President Donald Trump has announced that Washington will end its annual military funding to Israel, worth approximately $4 billion, by the end of 2026. Trump says he has reached an agreement with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and argues that Israel no longer needs the assistance. However, the announcement raises questions about the future of the existing US-Israel military aid agreement, which provides $3.8 billion annually through 2028, and the role of Congress in any change.
